# START HERE

## Text to picture, adult (Liberty)

Type what you want to see, then press **Run**.

**This model is explicit by default.** Its author says you can get explicit images even from prompts that did not ask for them, so do not run it where someone might be looking over your shoulder.

It is an older SD 1.5 model, so this workflow is set to **512x512** rather than the 1024x1024 the other picture workflows use. Making it bigger here tends to produce two heads and spare limbs — raise the size with an upscale afterwards instead.

Its author also says it is *"not an easy to prompt model, nor the best one for begginers"*, and describes plain sentences as working better than lists of tags. "A photo of..." is a good way in.

---

Nothing here can break your setup. If you change something by mistake, close the tab without saving and open the workflow again.

*Added by Toolshed. The graph is Comfy Org's SDXL template with the latent size and prompts changed for SD 1.5.*
